channel.title: Microsoft 365 Message Center and Roadmap Archive
channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1454113: Microsoft Copilot Word: Document summarization experience moving
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft Word's document summarization will move from the Top of Doc experience to other Copilot surfaces, maintaining AI-powered summaries accessible via Copilot prompts. No admin action is needed, but user communication and training updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1446805: Microsoft Viva: Targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva introduces targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard, allowing authorized users (CxO or delegates) to send Viva Pulse surveys to predefined Copilot user groups dynamically filtered from dashboard data. The feature rolls out from mid-August to mid-November 2026, enabled by default for eligible organizations.

item.title: MC1438561: Microsoft Purview Data loss prevention: debug tools activity now visible in managed app rules
item.description: Microsoft decided not to proceed with making debug tools activity visible in managed app DLP rules for Microsoft Edge for Business. The protection blocking developer tools remains enforced by default, with no changes to enforcement or user experience. No action is required from administrators.

item.title: MC1484013: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app for users with multi-line calling, organizing call activity by phone line. The rollout begins early November 2026, with no action required. This update affects desktop and web Teams and simplifies managing multiple phone lines.

item.title: MC1470410: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection for messages from external users
item.description: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting mid-October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can reveal images if trusted. No admin action is needed, but admins should inform users and update related guidance. The feature applies across all Teams platforms automatically.

item.title: MC1462921: Calls popout into a new window on the browser to support multi-tasking and collaboration during a meeting
item.description: Microsoft Teams for Web will introduce a Picture-in-Picture Call Monitor starting mid-October 2026, allowing users to manage meetings in a separate window while multitasking in other browser tabs. No admin action is needed, but users should have supported browsers and support staff should be informed.

item.title: MC1485411: Microsoft Excel: Excel canvas
item.description: Excel canvas, a new Copilot feature in Microsoft Excel, creates dynamic reports with visualizations and insights that update automatically with data changes. Available worldwide by late October 2026, it supports natural language interaction for report customization. No action is required; notify users and update training materials as needed.

item.title: MC1486295: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Generate smart tables of contents for PDFs on the web with Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot users can generate AI-created, hierarchical, clickable tables of contents for PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web starting December 2026. The feature is user-initiated, respects permissions, supports saving by editors, and may have inaccuracies, especially with scanned PDFs.

item.title: MC1422063: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
item.description: OneDrive for Business on Windows will improve sync error messages for paths exceeding 520 characters, guiding users to rename or move items without stopping sync. This update, rolling out from late October to November 2026, aims to reduce confusion and support tickets with no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1338816: New Outlook for Windows becomes available for GCC High and DoD
item.description: New Outlook for Windows will be available in GCC High and DoD environments starting Public Preview July 30, 2026, has rolled out. It remains off by default and opt-in, allowing admins control via policies and registry keys. Migration from COM to web add-ins is recommended.

item.title: MC1479277: Microsoft Copilot: New ways to work across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365
item.description: Microsoft Copilot updates include a new Home experience, enhanced Office integration, Code and Autopilot features, and an enterprise-grade Managed Runtime platform. SharePoint and OneDrive Copilot are generally available. Usage-based billing requires spending policies. Updates roll out starting October 2026 with admin controls for access and cost management.

item.title: RM489232: Microsoft Edge: Adding support for viewing Sensitivity labels applied to a Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) Protected PDF
item.description: Enterprise customers can view sensitivity labels applied to MIP protected PDF to be well informed of the data classification to enable them to handle such sensitive documents. This change will be available in the new PDF viewer on Microsoft Edge.

item.title: RM493752: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Cloud Attachments preservation for users on hold
item.description: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site. This is a new capability which is different from the existing capability of applying label to cloud attachments and links present in OneDrive and SharePoint and shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot

item.title: RM506749: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
item.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM516043: Microsoft Edge: PDF Viewer Performance Improvement and Minor Visual Updates
item.description: The PDF Viewer in Microsoft Edge is enhancing responsiveness and introducing a series of subtle visual upgrades aimed at improving overall usability and utility. This migration ensures UI coherence with the rest of the browser while maintaining the same user experience.

item.title: RM503771: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
item.description: Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.

item.title: RM522096: Microsoft Purview: Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access to enable sensitive file filtering at the network layer
item.description: Extend Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies to filter sensitive files at the network layer by integrating with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect files at the network layer and enforce restrictive actions based on DLP policy conditions. It helps prevent sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications through browsers, apps, APIs, add-ins, and more - including generative AI platforms, clou...

item.title: RM548648: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Windows console
item.description: With Teams Rooms on Windows consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

item.title: RM555852: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
item.description: This update introduces a co-branding experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app that helps organizations present an admin approved visual identifier directly within the Chat screen. Specifically, the experience enables administrators to leverage the organization-supported logo already managed in the Microsoft Admin Center theming settings and display it in the footer of the Chat screen, paired with a fixed label: “Approved by”.

item.title: RM558436: Microsoft Purview: Credential Scanning in Data Security Posture Agent
item.description: We're expanding the Data Security Posture Agent with a new credential scanning capability. Discover exposed credentials and data security risks across scoped locations. Assign scanning tasks to the agent, track progress across stages, and take action on prioritized findings. The agent scans selected data locations, analyzing scoped files to detect credentials, such as Microsoft Entra user credentials, private keys, and API tokens. Each finding includes a risk score, AI-generated insights, confid...

item.title: RM559105: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
item.description: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

item.title: RM561490: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

item.title: RM566528: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Extend Purview data security to the network layer via Entra GSA integration
item.description: Extend Microsoft Purview data security controls to the network layer to detect and protect sensitive data in text and prompts by integrating with Entra Internet Access. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforce restrictive actions based on DLP policies, and detect risky user activity through Insider Risk Management. It helps prevent sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications through browsers, app...

item.title: RM564913: Outlook: New Outlook for Windows for GCC-H and DoD
item.description: The new Microsoft Outlook for Windows will be available for US Government clouds (GCC-H and DoD sovereign environments).

item.title: RM565868: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
item.description: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.

item.title: RM566323: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - File Testing Against Sensitive Information Classifiers
item.description: A new feature will be introduced on the main Classification page, allowing users to test files against all available classifiers to identify the presence of sensitive information. Users will have the option to select a single classifier or run tests across all classifiers. This capability is designed to help users identify sensitive content within files and troubleshoot classification issues more efficiently.

item.title: RM139457: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Just in time protection (JIT) on SharePoint
item.description: Microsoft has decided to not move forward with this feature.

item.title: RM571687: Microsoft Teams: Add alternate text to images shared from OneDrive and SharePoint
item.description: Improve accessibility by adding alternate text to images shared in Teams from OneDrive and SharePoint, helping users better understand visual content

item.title: RM565216: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
item.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

item.title: RM573157: Microsoft Teams: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings
item.description: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings helps users identify potentially deceptive participants and meeting organizers. When Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt, it surfaces warnings and risk indicators to help users recognize suspicious identities and make more informed decisions when joining or participating in a meeting.

item.title: RM573451: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video (deepfake) detection in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video (deepfake) detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls. Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences for...

item.title: RM573267: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality evaluation - Recurring conversation evaluations
item.description: Quality Evaluation now supports recurring frequency for conversation evaluations. Previously, only event-based trigger evaluations were supported, meaning evaluations were created only when a conversation closed.

item.title: RM573275: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Add multiple items to a transaction using bulk entry
item.description: Associates can trigger the Bulk add operation from the button grid on the transaction screen in Store Commerce. A drawer-based dialog opens where associates can paste or enter multiple item number and quantity pairs, with one pair specified per line.

item.title: RM564970: Outlook: Improved PDF Preview on iOS
item.description: MIP-label protected PDFs are now supported in the PDF previewer along with a built-in control's toolbar for easier navigation.

item.title: RM573697: OneDrive: Presentation mode for PDFs in the iOS app on iPad
item.description: Microsoft OneDrive is introducing presentation mode in the OneDrive iOS app for users on iPad devices. Users select a new Presentation button in the PDF viewer to enter a focused, view-only experience that prevents free gesture scrolling between pages, reducing accidental page changes while presenting without moving the file to another app. The feature is not available on iPhone.

item.title: RM573699: SharePoint: Advanced Management - Inactive files policy
item.description: SharePoint administrators can use the Inactive files policy in SharePoint Advanced Management to automatically archive files based on when they were last accessed. The public preview is available through PowerShell only. Admins can set an inactivity threshold from 6 to 48 months, scope policies to all SharePoint sites or selected sites, include or exclude file types and sites, and use What-If mode to review impact before activation. Eligible files move to the Microsoft 365 Archive cold-storage t...

item.title: MC1488847: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will support breakout rooms, allowing meeting organizers to assign and move these devices between breakout and main rooms. This feature, improving coordination and feature parity with Windows, will roll out worldwide from mid to late November 2026. No action is required.

item.title: MC1488845: Private tasks now stored in your private plan in Planner
item.description: Starting November 2026, private tasks in Microsoft Planner will be stored in users' private Planner plans instead of Microsoft To Do, enabling richer features while remaining private. Existing tasks stay visible in Planner. No admin action is needed, but organizations should update documentation and compliance processes accordingly.

item.title: MC1488844: Updated My Task experience in Planner
item.description: Microsoft Planner's My Tasks experience will be redesigned for clearer navigation, better task organization, and streamlined task creation, enhancing productivity. The update rolls out worldwide from early to late November 2026, requires no user action, and preserves existing tasks and settings.

item.title: MC1488843: Microsoft Word for Android: Agent Mode
item.description: Microsoft Word for Android will gain Copilot Agent Mode by late September 2026, enabling users to draft, reason, and refine content with AI assistance. No admin action is needed, but organizations should update guidance and review policies to align with this new task-oriented Copilot experience.

item.title: MC1488841: Microsoft Outlook: Update to default blocked file types in OwaMailboxPolicy
item.description: Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows will block .msix and .msixbundle file types by default in OwaMailboxPolicy starting November 2026 to enhance security. Organizations using these file types should whitelist them beforehand; no action is needed if not used.

item.title: MC1488834: Microsoft Entra ID: Final reminder to replace MemberOf rule operator configurations by November 3, 2026
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will retire the MemberOf rule operator by November 3, 2026. Organizations must replace MemberOf in dynamic groups, administrative units, and entitlement policies to avoid outdated memberships, access, and licensing issues. After this date, MemberOf-based updates will stop, impacting Conditional Access and related services.

item.title: MC1462473: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
item.description: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams will add a light mode option for presenters, alongside dark, classic, and high contrast modes. This update, rolling out from early September to late October 2026, enhances flexibility and accessibility without affecting presentation content or attendee views. No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1446797: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will receive a modernized Gallery view from mid-August to late October 2026, aligning it with Windows. Updates include consistent participant layouts, video prioritization, new display controls, and admin settings. No action is required before rollout; communication to users is recommended.

item.title: MC1404321: Microsoft Teams: Emoji shortcuts expand to iOS and Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding desktop-style emoji shortcuts to iOS and Android, allowing users to insert emojis by typing keywords between colons (e.g., :smile:). The rollout begins mid-August 2026, enhancing mobile emoji input with no admin controls and requiring no user action.

item.title: MC1259828: Microsoft Purview: Credential scanning in Data Security Posture Agent
item.description: Microsoft Purview planned to add a credential scanning feature in the Data Security Posture Agent using LLM-powered detection to identify exposed credentials and provide risk insights. However, the general availability rollout was canceled as of October 5, 2026. Admin setup and communication were advised before cancellation.

item.title: MC1479519: Agents and Skills in CIQ
item.description: Users can now insert Agents and Skills directly into prompts via the Context IQ menu or by typing / or @, enhancing discovery and productivity. This feature rolls out worldwide from mid-September to late September 2026, requires no user action, and supports CIQ and Copilot experiences.

item.title: MC1485120: Outlook (new): Right-click to customize the classic ribbon
item.description: Users can now customize the classic ribbon in New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the Web by right-clicking the ribbon on the Home or View tab, selecting Customize, and arranging commands and groups. Rollout began September 2026, completing by mid-November 2026. No action required.

item.title: MC1488488: Microsoft Dataverse - Bulk generate prompt column values for existing records (backfill)
item.description: We are introducing bulk generation of prompt column values for existing Dataverse records. Now, you can have AI-generated values across existing data without requiring record updates to trigger execution. This feature will reach general availability on November 16, 2026. How does this affect me? When selected, this capability will run asynchronously as a background job and will consume Copilot or AIB credits. Users can monitor and manage the job and view its credit usage in System Jobs. Two envi...

item.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Migration to Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy is required by mid-October 2026 to avoid service disruption. Gov rollout is paused; updates will be shared via Message center.

item.title: MC1483529: Dynamics 365 and Power Platform– Information about storage validation for Dataverse-only tenants
item.description: Beginning November 9, 2026, we are introducing staged storage validation for supported Dynamics 365 applications. The change gives administrators clearer visibility into storage use, advance notice of potential restrictions, and several ways to remain within capacity, including removing unneeded data, adding capacity, or enabling pay-as-you-go for sandbox environments. item.description: Beginning November 9, 2026, we are introducing staged storage validation for supported Dynamics 365 applications. item.title: MC1166852: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics launches new agent dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics introduces a new Agent Dashboard for tracking agent adoption trends and Copilot credit usage, rolling out publicly in February 2026. It offers detailed metrics, retention trends, and agent insights, accessible via Viva Insights, with controls for managing access and no identified compliance issues.

item.title: MC1486291: Microsoft 365 Copilot: new guided Copilot onboarding experience
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces an optional, admin-enabled guided onboarding experience for Frontier participants starting late October 2026. It offers personalized role-based training via the Copilot app to boost adoption and confidence, with Starter and Premium journeys, admin controls, and Viva Learning reporting.

item.title: MC1486289: Microsoft Purview |Unified Classification Management Experience
item.description: Microsoft Purview is launching a unified Classification Management experience for admins to manage classifiers consistently. Public Preview starts early October 2026; General Availability by late November 2026. It integrates various classifier types and includes admin controls manageable via Entra ID group membership.

item.title: MC1486284: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Administrative Units support for DLP policies for Microsoft Copilot
item.description: Microsoft Purview extends Microsoft Entra Administrative Units support to Copilot DLP policies, enabling delegated management within units while maintaining existing RBAC. Rollout starts late October 2026. No action required; organizations using AUs should review structure and assignments. Tenant-wide policies remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1486282: Action required: Update Teams devices to a minimum app version ahead of the retirement of Exchange Web Services (EWS)
item.description: Update Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android, phones, and panels to the minimum app version released in February 2026 before October 2026 to avoid losing calendar functionality due to the retirement of Exchange Web Services (EWS). Devices below this version may lose calendar sync and one-touch join features.

item.title: RM573280: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
item.description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

item.title: RM561040: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys - AI-powered task completion for Microsoft 365 Copilot users
item.description: Commercial Journeys helps information workers stay on top of their most important work when browsing in Microsoft Edge. Powered by AI, it proactively surfaces unfinished, new, and recurring tasks on the Copilot new tab page- with context-rich cards that explain why each task matters now. One click opens a guided execution flow that delivers ready-to-use outputs (emails, documents, presentations, and more), so users can complete their unfinished work faster with higher quality. This feature will...

item.title: RM571682: Power Apps: Modern, refreshed look for embedded model-driven apps
item.description: Extends the modern, refreshed look to embedded app experiences so model-driven app content retains consistent Fluent styling and interaction patterns when it appears inside another host. This was previously enabled for the monthly channel with the 2602.1 release and is now being enabled for the semiannual channel with the 2609.3 release.

item.title: RM571675: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Automate optimizations with Scheduling Operations Agent
item.description: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include the ability to create recurring optimizations on a schedule. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. The agent automatically runs optimizations and applies the results on the configured schedule.

item.title: RM571400: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
item.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

item.title: RM571394: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Dataverse Business Skills in Sales Agent
item.description: Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization. Business Skills enable organizations to create natural language instructions for Sales Agent to follow, which represent their business processes, policies, and business knowledge. Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief c...

item.title: RM573156: Microsoft Teams: Start side conversations during meetings
item.description: Keep collaboration moving without disrupting the main discussion. Start and continue one-to-one or small-group conversations directly from a meeting to ask questions, coordinate next steps, share information, and collaborate in parallel while staying engaged in the conversation, reducing context switching and helping teams stay focused and productive.

item.title: RM552598: Microsoft Edge: Improvements to site permissions user interfaces
item.description: To better align with user expectations, site permissions are changing to look and work both in context on a website that is requesting permissions and when navigating to permissions from Settings. On a website that is requesting permissions, there are changes to the Omnibox and the Page Info dialog and permissions will be easier to see and modify in Settings.

item.title: RM573452: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
item.description: Help people get started faster by automatically connecting new team members to relevant channels when they join a team. Improve engagement, accelerate onboarding, and make it easier to discover important information from day one.

item.title: MC1486027: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration - Secure Dataverse record with column-based filtering
item.description: We are announcing the ability for admins to use filtered views to select and manage record-level access securely by defining security based on certain values of a field in Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration. This feature will reach public preview on October 2, 2026. How does this affect me? item.title: MC1469551: Teams admin center device state rules and health alerts retire; use Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams admin center's device state rules and health alerts will retire by late October 2026, moving device health monitoring to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal. Admins must reconfigure alerts and integrations in the new portal; end-user experience remains unchanged. Existing TAC configurations won't migrate.

item.title: MC1279093: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Enhancing how we handle promotional mail
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will tag promotional emails as “promotions” and can auto-move them to a Promotions folder, learning from user actions. Public preview starts mid-April 2026; general rollout completes by late 2026. Admins control settings; users can customize via message moves.

item.title: MC1485169: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Use role-based enforcement for recording and transcription downloads
item.description: We are announcing the ability to use role-based enforcement for recording and transcription downloads in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 31, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature helps organizations better protect sensitive customer communications by separating permissions to view recordings and transcripts from permissions to download them. Admins can assign new Dataverse security roles to prevent selected users from downloading recordi...

item.title: RM569721: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
item.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

item.title: RM569432: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
item.description: B2B users, including internal guest users and external users, will be able to register and sign in with passkeys issued by a resource tenant to meet that tenant's multifactor authentication (MFA) requirements. Today, passkeys are supported for member users in their home tenant. With this update, B2B users can register a resource tenant passkey from the resource tenant's My Security Info page, or in-line during a proof-up prompt or passkey registration campaign, and then use it to satisfy the res...

item.title: RM571692: Microsoft Edge: Updated performance information in tab hover cards
item.description: Microsoft Edge is updating tab hover cards to provide clearer information about tab memory usage and memory savings when inactive tabs are discarded. Users will also have separate settings for tab-preview images and memory-usage information.

item.title: RM569421: Microsoft Teams: Malicious URL Protection for Teams Chat and Channels for Gov clouds
item.description: Microsoft Teams can now detect and warn users on malicious URLs sent in Teams chat and channels in Gov clouds, increasing protection against malware attacks for Gov clouds customers.

item.title: RM568762: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
item.description: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.

item.title: RM568369: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Different Content to Learning Groups in a Single Assignment
item.description: Enable educators to assign different content (attachments, resources, instructions) to different Individual Groups within a single Assignment. Today teachers must create separate assignments to differentiate — one for advanced readers, another for struggling students, etc. This feature collapses that into one assignment with group-specific content mapping.

item.title: RM566865: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Admin assignment time limit
item.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing the ability to set a limit in days when assigning users and security groups to role groups. This allows admins to define a fixed duration when providing admin permission on a temporary basis.

item.title: RM560548: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Configure user and survey data retention for deleted users in Viva Glint
item.description: With the new control in Viva Glint, service administrators can now configure whether to retain or delete survey and relevant indefinable user data for users who are manually deleted from Glint or deleted via the signals received via Microsoft Entra. This will ensure that the consistency of previously generate Glint survey reports is retained and user data is handled in accordance with the relevant organizational policies. item.title: RM559613: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
item.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

item.title: RM515465: Microsoft Teams: Adaptive card-based app & copilot agent link unfurling in Teams
item.description: Discover and add SharePoint agents in chats and channels from in-context store. Users can click on 'Add agents and bots' from the roster drop down. This will open the in-context store, where users can discover SharePoint agents and add them directly to the conversation and collaborate in the group. Updated January 29, 2026: Due to a blocker we have paused rollout until March for this feature. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM513275: Microsoft Viva: Engage Community feed improvements
item.description: Align the community feeds default experience with expected user behaviors; support triage and content review for users who want to read every message in a community.

item.title: RM492622: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.

item.title: RM573244: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Migrate finance and operations environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
item.description: The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.
item.category: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

item.title: RM566529: Microsoft Purview: View only Role management enhancements

item.description: The updated Service application brings Dynamics 365 Customer Service context, actions, and guided workflows into Scout. Customer service teams can work with service information and take supported actions in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365.

item.description: The updated Service application brings Dynamics 365 Customer Service context, actions, and guided workflows into Code. Customer service teams can work with service information and take supported actions in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365.

item.description: The updated Sales plugin brings expanded Dynamics 365 Sales context, actions, and guided workflows to Copilot Cowork, building on the native Sales skills already available in Cowork. item.description: Manage agents more easily by grouping avatars and using a dedicated action to start new tasks.

item.title: RM573371: Dynamics 365 Business Central: User experiences - Show recently searched in Tell Me
item.description: Find pages and reports faster by accessing recent searches in Tell Me (Alt+Q).

item.description: This feature extends sustainability tracking to fixed assets by introducing fields and logic that capture emissions during acquisition, reclassification, and disposal. Posting rules maintain data integrity across your fixed asset and sustainability ledgers.

item.title: RM573370: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Manage agent permissions easier
item.description: Assign additional permissions to agents when they request them.

item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will add two new Advanced Hunting tables, SubmissionEvents and SubmissionResults, providing security teams enhanced visibility into email submissions. item.description: Microsoft is introducing a Microsoft plugin registry for Copilot experiences and Microsoft 365 apps, centralizing discovery, publishing, and governance of plugins. The Agents-related buttons will be replaced by a Plugins button by late November 2026, with no action required from admins. Updates to documentation and user preparation are recommended.

item.title: MC1484007: Updated Copilot in Microsoft Edge Experience
item.description: Microsoft Edge's Copilot is updated with a new icon, simplified UX, and enhanced features like Voice and Vision. item.description: Upgrade the ExchangeOnlineManagement PowerShell module to version 3.10.1 or later by March 31, 2027, to avoid authentication failures due to new security enhancements. item.description: The Brand pane in Microsoft PowerPoint has been temporarily removed to improve the experience based on user feedback. It is unavailable on Windows, Mac, and web versions. item.description: Microsoft PowerPoint no longer includes Brand Guidelines and Style when creating new Brand Kits to simplify the process. Existing Brand Kits retain this content. No action or policy changes are needed, but users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1405506: Microsoft OneNote: Multimodal recording in Copilot Notebooks on Windows
item.description: Microsoft is introducing multimodal capture in OneNote Copilot Notebooks on Windows, enabling audio, image, and note capture with AI-generated summaries and action items. item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) will add a Copilot chat pane with a Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android) by end of October 2026, enabling users to generate summaries and ask questions about notes. Existing Copilot controls apply; no admin action is needed before rollout.

item.description: Today, Insider Risk Management (IRM) provides policy-driven protection for data leaks, data theft, and risky AI usage. item.title: RM543422: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Excel Agent
item.description: Excel Agent helps you turn data into clear charts, summaries, and insights using built‑in formulas and logic. item.title: RM571880: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover & Add Skills from the skill catalog

item.description: Live subtitles for voice chats in Copilot will be available for users to help them follow the conversation when using the quick composer.

item.title: MC1449180: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention and auto-labeling support for non-Microsoft applications
item.description: Microsoft Purview is expanding Data Loss Prevention and auto-labeling support to non-Microsoft apps like Google Workspace, Box, and Salesforce via Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. Administrators can create and manage policies directly in Purview starting early October 2026, with global availability by late October.

item.description: Outlook attachments now use a separate application configuration enforcing existing Conditional Access policies for download, preview, and upload. Non-compliant users are blocked from attachment actions. Admins should review policies, update help desk guidance, and notify users. Excluding attachments from policies requires creating a service principal for OwaDownloadAttachments.

item.title: MC1478975: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Use Microsoft Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
item.description: Microsoft 365 now supports Microsoft Agent 365 agents using the Agent2Agent protocol as connected agents in declarative agents, expanding integration options. Administrators manage and approve these agents via the Microsoft 365 admin center. Rollout began late August 2026, enabling enhanced AI interactions and workflows.

item.title: MC1478958: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Select page canvas elements for Copilot-assisted editing
item.description: SharePoint Online now lets page authors with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license select specific page canvas elements for targeted Copilot editing, improving precision and user experience. This feature is generally available worldwide with no action required.

item.title: MC1465768: Microsoft Teams: Users can temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams will let users temporarily pause notifications for a chosen time to reduce interruptions and improve focus. This feature, available on desktop, web, and mobile, rolls out worldwide from mid-September to late October 2026. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1477184: Microsoft 365 admin center: Agent Registry consolidates duplicate agent entries and adds version history
item.description: Microsoft 365 admin center's Agent Registry now consolidates duplicate agent entries into single records with version history, simplifying management and governance. Rollout occurs mid-September to mid-October 2026. Admins should update reports and documentation due to changes in agent counts; no action is required.

item.title: MC1387681: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Policy recommendation panel in IRM
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will introduce a policy recommendation panel by early 2027 to help administrators identify and address gaps in insider risk policies using analytics. The feature is enabled by default, improves risk coverage visibility, and requires no user workflow changes or action.

item.title: MC1470887: Microsoft Teams: Personal message reminders for chat and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce personal message reminders for chat and channel messages starting early November 2026, enabling users to set, manage, and receive notifications for reminders. item.title: MC1458470: Simplified Copilot experience in Microsoft Outlook

item.title: MC1288531: Microsoft Viva - Copilot Analytics: Export agent data from the Agent Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva will add a feature allowing eligible users with at least 50 Copilot licenses to export de-identified Copilot agent usage data from the Agent Dashboard for analysis. item.title: MC1454397: Updates to Tenant External Recipient Rate Limit (TERRL) Quotas for New, Trial, and Education Tenants
item.description: Starting mid-September to November 2026, Exchange Online updates Tenant External Recipient Rate Limit (TERRL) quotas for new, trial, and education tenants, adjusting limits based on tenant age and license type. Trial quotas reduce to 500 recipients daily; EDU licenses get a new quota formula. No immediate action required.

item.title: MC1481325: Microsoft SharePoint: Retirement of SharePoint Page Agent (Frontier)
item.description: Microsoft will retire the SharePoint Page Agent (Frontier) for SharePoint Online starting mid-October 2026, completing by mid-November 2026. Users must switch to creating and refining pages directly with Copilot in SharePoint. Existing content remains accessible with no migration needed. Organizations should update training and workflows accordingly.

item.title: MC1481318: Microsoft Defender XDR: Detection source support in alert tuning rules
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR will allow alert tuning rules to target specific detection sources for finer control. This feature rolls out in public preview mid-October 2026 and general availability mid-November 2026. Existing rules apply to all sources unless updated. No action is needed unless customization is desired.

item.title: MC1481317: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Retirement of Data Risk Graph
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is retiring the Data Risk Graph by December 8, 2026. Users must transition to Activity explorer, Content explorer, and User activity experiences for investigations. Existing policies and workflows remain unaffected; no user action is required for the feature removal.

item.title: MC1481316: Microsoft Teams: Enable Teams apps and agents for existing applications in your organization
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable admins to discover and recommend Teams apps and agents linked to third-party applications already used in their organization, improving integration and reducing app switching. This feature, rolling out in November 2026, requires admin activation and uses sign-in signals to generate recommendations without automatic changes.

item.title: MC1481315: Microsoft Purview: Retirement of Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) classic and DSPM for AI classic experiences
item.description: Microsoft will retire the Microsoft Purview DSPM classic and DSPM for AI classic experiences by December 31, 2026, unifying capabilities into a single current DSPM experience. Organizations using the classic versions must transition workflows to the new experience before retirement.

item.title: MC1481313: Microsoft Purview | DLM: Legacy Teams retention policies that cover Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
item.description: Legacy Microsoft Teams retention policies will no longer apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions starting late October 2026. Action is required if Copilot retention is needed.

item.title: MC1481310: Pin Copilot app to Windows taskbar for selected user groups
item.description: Microsoft 365 admins can now pin the Copilot app to the Windows taskbar for specific Intune-managed user groups via a new M365 admin center option. This rollout starts late September 2026 and requires the app to be pre-installed. Group-based pinning helps target departments or pilot groups.

item.title: MC1481309: Microsoft Entra ID: Enhance protection of the authentication experience by blocking external script injection

item.title: MC1456609: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a new auto-labeling policy coverage report to help administrators track labeling progress, identify issues, and assess policy effectiveness. item.title: RM568791: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities

item.title: RM571879: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings
item.description: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings gives organizations greater control over access to sensitive meetings. Administrators can apply Conditional Access policies to selected meetings, helping ensure participants meet organizational security requirements before joining.

item.title: RM570665: Outlook: Send availability in Outlook mobile apps

item.title: RM569363: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements

item.title: RM571309: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

item.title: RM571884: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
item.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

item.title: RM570857: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Track costs for non-billable field work
item.description: Organizations often use the same field teams for both customer work and internal operational work, such as maintenance, inspections, or asset-related activities that are not billed to an external customer. item.title: RM568792: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities

item.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

item.description: Walking into a customer meeting with incomplete context can mean missed risks, overlooked issues, and conversations that fall flat. item.description: Sales agent gives you strong CRM-based account and opportunity summaries, but important context is often spread across non-CRM systems. item.title: RM567000: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage prospects faster with Sales Agent-enriched leads
item.description: To reach their sales goals, sales teams need to constantly generate enough pipeline. They need to decide which inbound leads to engage. This decision takes a lot of time because sellers must sift through large amounts of data across tools and data sources. This data includes information from internal systems like their CRM and external resources like the web and third-party data services.

item.title: RM565425: Microsoft Teams: Language selection by users in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now choose their preferred meeting language in Teams Rooms on Android. Select from up to 69 languages using the language button on the console. The room system must restart after a language is selected.

item.title: RM499076: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection- Scan existing files in SharePoint and OneDrive for business for sensitive information
item.description: This new capability will enable admins to scan existing files at rest in SharePoint or OneDrive for business for sensitive data.

item.title: RM498923: Viva Glint - Action Taking Report (Public Preview)
item.description: Introduction of a new report that provides transparency into platform activity by dashboard users. Metrics such as report views, Team Conversations completed, and Focus Areas created will be visible and filterable with this report.

item.title: RM409534: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will provide native Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) controls for connected cameras that support this capability, whether the camera moves a physical lens or adjusts the image digitally. Controls are available when Teams Rooms can confirm the camera isn't independently framing the room.

item.title: RM386901: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity label grouping modernization
item.description: To help improve label usability and configuration, the sensitivity labeling scheme will be simplified to only consist of labels and label groupings. These new label groupings allow admins to better organize and categorize their labels (previously done via parent labels).

item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, enhancing visibility and providing AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins mid-October 2026 worldwide, with no changes to licensing or admin settings. No action is required, but user communication is recommended.

item.title: MC1459138: Microsoft Teams: Local Pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will add native local Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera controls on the in-room console for compatible cameras, enabling manual adjustments during meetings without extra remotes. Rollout begins September 2026, with automatic enablement on eligible devices and no action required from users.

item.title: MC1479512: Microsoft Teams: Updates to Teams Events licensing for business, frontline, and education customers
item.description: Microsoft Teams Events licensing is updated to categorize features into foundational (available with eligible Teams licenses) and advanced (requiring Teams Enterprise licenses). Teams Premium no longer includes Events capabilities. Event attendee limits vary by license, with capacity packs needed for over 3,000 attendees. Admins must review organizer licenses accordingly.

item.title: MC1472592: Microsoft Purview: Auto-expanding archive capacity increases to 3 TB for eligible mailboxes
item.description: Microsoft Purview increases auto-expanding archive capacity for eligible Exchange Online mailboxes from 1.5 TB to 3 TB starting mid-October 2026. No extra configuration or charges apply. Administrators should verify license eligibility, monitor growth, and update documentation accordingly. Compliance impact is minimal.

item.title: MC1480873: Connected Platforms - Agent 365 extends observability to third-party agents
item.description: Microsoft Agent 365 now integrates observability for third-party agents from Amazon Bedrock Classic, AgentCore, Google Vertex AI, and Anthropic Claude Managed Agents into a unified experience. Administrators can monitor runs, sessions, tool calls, and exceptions across platforms. Rollout begins September 2026, with no action needed for existing connections unless observability is desired.

item.title: MC1480870: New SharePoint Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
item.description: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android is redesigned around a personalized Discover experience, launching mid-October 2026 worldwide. It features improved site browsing, file previews, refreshed news, search, dark mode, and better performance, with no admin action or compliance concerns required.

item.title: MC1480869: Microsoft 365 settings enabled by default for newly created Engage communities
item.description: Newly created Microsoft Viva Engage communities will have Microsoft 365 group settings enabled by default, subscribing members to community emails and calendar invites. Community owners can adjust these settings in the My Account portal. Rollout completes by mid-October 2026; no admin action is required.

item.title: RM564969: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing. With IntelliFrame’s expanded AI data channel, participants experience faster active speaker framing, people recognition and labels, and more responsive meeting views—even when network conditions are limited. These capabilities are available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM570858: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Support multiple warehouse assignments for field technicians
item.description: Field technicians often source parts from more than one warehouse. Limiting a technician to a single warehouse can make it harder to reflect how materials are actually sourced across field operations.

item.title: RM570967: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Maker Guidelines
item.description: The Maker guidelines feature gives organizations a direct way to share guidance with Copilot Studio makers in the flow of work. Administrators can explain which tools, models, connectors, and channels are approved for an environment and point makers to the right policy, request process, or support contact.
item.category: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

item.title: RM568781: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

item.title: RM516577: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
item.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

item.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

item.title: RM570862: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Support multiple payers across Work Order lines
item.description: Field work does not always have a single payer. A customer may be responsible for the primary service while another party, such as a warranty provider, manufacturer, partner, or other eligible billing customer, is responsible for specific products or services performed during the same visit.

item.title: RM501451: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in SharePoint
item.description: Simplifies SharePoint content management and ensures content is Copilot-ready by automating metadata, fixing stale content, enabling fast page creation, improving compliance, and enriching content so Copilot can deliver more accurate, grounded answers. item.description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open cloud documents in Copilot Chat in Edge.

item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

item.title: RM502520: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
item.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing. New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

item.title: MC1479517: SharePoint: HTML pages
item.description: SharePoint will support creating, uploading, editing, and publishing HTML pages, including Copilot-assisted page creation. Rollout starts October 2026 (preview) and completes December 2026 (general availability). Pages are stored in the Site Pages library with existing permissions. No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1479516: Microsoft Outlook: Link preview retirement
item.description: The link preview feature in new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web has been retired worldwide. Links will remain clickable but no longer show preview cards. No action is needed, but users should be informed about this change.

item.title: MC1479513: Outlook: Insert Symbols
item.description: Outlook will allow users to insert symbols into emails via the Insert tab, rolling out worldwide from October to December 2026. No admin action is needed, but users should be informed, and training materials updated. This affects new Outlook for Windows, Outlook on the web, and Exchange Online.

item.title: MC1479509: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
item.description: New Outlook will offer automatic spell check before sending emails, rolling out worldwide from mid-October to mid-December 2026. Users can enable this feature to reduce spelling errors without manual checks. No admin action is needed; update user guidance accordingly. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1479508: Microsoft Planner: Meeting-created plans will expire after 180 days of inactivity
item.description: Meeting-created Microsoft Planner plans from Teams expire and delete after 180 days of no task activity, starting October 2026. Organizers get advance email notices and can extend plans by selecting "Keep plan." Tasks in Loop and meeting notes remain unaffected. Deleted plans recoverable within 30 days via admin request.

item.title: MC1479506: Video recap in Microsoft Teams supports more languages
item.description: Microsoft Teams Video recap, which uses AI to create narrated highlight videos from meetings, now supports 23 languages and 31 locale variants. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot license users, it requires meetings to be 10–90 minutes, recorded, and transcribed. Rollout begins late September 2026.

item.title: MC1479505: ADO MCP in Copilot
item.description: The Azure DevOps MCP Connector integrates Azure DevOps with Microsoft 365 Copilot Deep Work, enabling natural-language queries on work items and project data. Rolling out worldwide in October 2026, it supports multi-step workflows, admin controls, and user-confirmed write actions, enhancing project analysis and automation.

item.title: MC1479503: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Permission changes for select App Governance Entra roles
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is updating App Governance permissions for select Microsoft Entra roles to align with Defender XDR Unified RBAC. Changes affect Cloud App Security, Compliance Administrator, and Compliance Data Administrator roles starting mid-October 2026. Admins should review and adjust role assignments accordingly.

item.title: MC1478970: Microsoft Purview | DLP-Create Purview network data security policies without pay-as-you-go configuration
item.description: Microsoft Purview network data security policies can now be created without pay-as-you-go configuration, using Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access with appropriate licensing. Non-Microsoft integrations still require pay-as-you-go. Rollout begins late September 2026, enabling policy creation to protect sensitive data in network traffic automatically.

item.title: MC1187682: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support summarization and contextual grounding
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Business now supports Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for summarizing and contextualizing multiple browser tabs, YouTube videos (available), and Microsoft 365 documents (rolling out mid-October 2026). The feature is off by default, respects DLP and policy settings, and requires Entra ID sign-in and proper licensing.

item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android will support attendee proximity join for Teams events, enabling users to quickly connect to nearby room systems. Rollout starts November 2026, completing by December. No action is needed; the feature will be enabled automatically to simplify joining meetings.

item.title: MC1478463: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Teams user reporting enabled by default
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will enable Teams user reporting by default starting late October 2026 for licensed organizations. Users can report suspicious Teams content to improve threat detection. Admins can review or opt out via a dedicated Defender portal page before October 25, 2026.

item.title: MC1442614: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will gain enhanced IntelliFrame AI features via certified intelligent cameras, enabling faster speaker framing, participant recognition, and smoother views, especially in low bandwidth. AI processing occurs on-device with metadata sent through a dedicated channel. Rollout begins mid-January 2027, enabled by default, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1461152: Create interactive slides in PowerPoint with Copilot skill (Windows and Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint is introducing "Create interactive slides" for Windows, Mac, and web, enabling users to make interactive visuals for complex concepts and data. Available first to Microsoft 365 Insider Beta and Frontier users, rollout completes by October 2026. No action required; admins should prepare support and training.

item.title: MC1479276: Microsoft Copilot: Evolving the Copilot pricing model and new FinOps capabilities for AI
item.description: Microsoft is evolving Copilot's pricing with a user subscription license for everyday AI and usage-based billing (UBB) for advanced AI via Copilot Credits. New FinOps tools enable admins to manage costs, spending policies, and monitor usage. UBB rolls out in Q4 2026; admins must set policies to enable credit use.

item.title: MC1478969: Deprecation of Citrix mVPN Support in Microsoft Edge for Android
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Android will retire Citrix Mobile VPN (mVPN) integration starting mid-September 2026 due to compatibility issues. Organizations using this integration must identify affected users, assess dependencies, plan migration to alternative solutions, and communicate changes before support ends. Other Edge features remain unaffected.

item.title: MC1478966: SharePoint: Improved site metadata size reporting
item.description: SharePoint will improve site metadata size reporting by including document library field data, providing a more complete usage view. The 1 TB metadata limit remains, but reported sizes may increase, potentially blocking new metadata additions if exceeded. Rollout starts October 20, 2026, with no content changes.

item.title: MC1478965: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will support retention of inactive Microsoft 365 Copilot memory versions for compliance and investigation. Historical memory items are stored in users' Exchange mailboxes, accessible via eDiscovery. Rollout begins late September 2026. No immediate action is required; organizations should review retention policies and governance.

item.title: MC1478961: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Windows: Organization skill support
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Windows will support organization skills that admins can upload and share tenant-wide via the Microsoft 365 admin center, enabling centralized governance and consistent user experiences. Rollout begins September 2026, with no immediate action required unless publishing skills.

item.title: MC1478960: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Mac: Organization skill support
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint for Mac will support organization skills that admins can upload and share tenant-wide via the Microsoft 365 admin center, enabling centralized governance and consistent user experiences. item.title: MC1478956: Microsoft Windows Autopatch: enhancements to update approval control and management capabilities
item.description: Windows Autopatch enhancements, rolling out Sept 1–Oct 15, 2026, offer improved control over Windows quality, .NET Framework, and quick machine recovery updates. item.description: Microsoft Project Online will retire on September 30, 2026. item.title: MC1478949: Breakout Rooms for Microsoft Teams Webinars now support up to 1,000 participants and 100 rooms
item.description: Breakout Rooms in Microsoft Teams webinars now support up to 1,000 participants and 100 rooms, enabling large-scale interactive sessions like training and workshops. item.description: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update will allow Monthly Enterprise Channel devices to roll back to releases from two versions prior with security updates, maintaining that state until updates resume. item.title: RM392839: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Automatic data preservation for high-risk users
item.description: Adaptive Protection in Microsoft Purview helps you protect your organization’s data by integrating dynamic insider risk levels, determined by data related activities, with various policy engines to automatically moving users in and out of policies as their risk levels change over time. item.description: Extend your sensitivity labels to specific or all subscriptions within Azure Storage and Azure SQL Server via auto-labeling policy. item.title: RM558547: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
item.description: Speed up analysis of exfiltrated content by launching Data Security Investigations (DSI) from endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alerts. In DSI, define your endpoint DLP query (for example, time range, users, and endpoints). DSI then automatically gathers the related files that triggered the alerts for review (for example, UserA downloaded a file on 3/1/2026).

item.title: RM560700: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM566322: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
item.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. item.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. item.title: RM568782: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
item.description: Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

item.title: RM570846: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment

Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

item.title: RM571387: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility

item.title: RM571191: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Detailed quality evaluation score breakdown
item.description: Evaluation details now include a scoring breakdown at the overall, section, and question level. Users can see how the final evaluation score was calculated, including how individual question outcomes contribute to section scores and the overall score. This improves transparency, helps quality teams validate results, and makes it easier to identify areas for coaching, calibration, and process improvement.

item.title: RM571192: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Support Not Applicable answer option for quality evaluation criteria
item.description: Criteria questions now support a Not Applicable answer option. When a question is marked as not applicable, it is excluded from scoring instead of negatively affecting the evaluation score. This helps ensure evaluations remain accurate when a specific criterion does not apply to the case, interaction, or business scenario being reviewed.

item.title: RM571193: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Inactivate quality evaluation records
item.description: Quality managers can now inactivate evaluation records that should no longer contribute to scoring or reporting. Inactive evaluations are preserved for traceability but excluded from overall score calculations and analytics. This helps teams correct reporting outcomes when evaluations were created in error, used the wrong criteria, were duplicates, or should otherwise be removed from active quality results.

item.title: RM571302: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Quality evaluation supports knowledge source in criteria
item.description: Criteria questions can now use knowledge sources to help evaluate customer interactions. This allows organizations to ground evaluation criteria in approved knowledge content, policies, or guidance so quality checks can better reflect expected handling standards. This preview capability is scoped to case and on-demand evaluations.

item.title: RM569019: Microsoft Teams: Identify custom apps that need updates for Teams private and shared channels
item.description: Admins will be able to view in Teams Admin Center a list of custom apps in their tenant that need to be updated to work in private and shared channels. This experience will help admins identify impacted apps, understand which apps require developer action, and coordinate updates so users can continue using custom apps across all supported channel types.

item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Surveys agent by August 31, 2026, transitioning users to a unified Copilot-powered experience within Microsoft Forms. Existing users lose access by December 2026. No licensing changes are needed; workflows continue seamlessly with enhanced AI features. Users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1290821: eSignature for Microsoft 365 - Recipient groups
item.description: Microsoft 365 eSignature introduces recipient groups, allowing up to 10 people per recipient slot, with the first signer fulfilling the requirement. This reduces delays in signature workflows. Public preview ends late September 2026; general availability runs December 2026. No admin action needed; feature respects existing policies.

item.title: MC1429018: Microsoft Teams: AI meeting archive file generation
item.description: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting archive files starting early November 2026 to improve Copilot and Facilitator responses while ensuring privacy. Archives are stored in tenant-owned SharePoint, accessible only to meeting participants, and governed by configurable retention policies. Admin controls will be available before rollout.

item.title: MC1462915: Allow connections to copilot.cloud.microsoft before the Copilot URL redirect
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft will redirect users from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft. Organizations must ensure network and security controls allow connections to *.cloud.microsoft to avoid Copilot access disruptions across web, desktop, and Edge apps. Validate connectivity and update allow lists before October.

item.title: MC1475801: Dynamics 365 Contact Center – Enable AI-assisted time-off and swap requests
item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable AI-assisted time-off and swap requests in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 1, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables an AI-assisted solution that provides automation for workforce schedules and approvals, governance across time‑off requests, shift bidding, and shift swapping. item.title: MC1474455: In-app browsing in Copilot app
item.description: The Microsoft Copilot app now supports in-app browsing on Windows and Mac, allowing users to open websites side-by-side with chat. Administrators can opt-in selected devices to test this feature, manage policies, and prepare support. Browsing data is stored locally, and users can open links externally if desired.

item.title: MC1475456: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Perform bulk operations for bookings on schedule board
item.description: We are announcing the ability to move or reassign multiple bookings at once, directly from the schedule board in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature eliminates repetitive, manual edits required during common scenarios such as resource replacement, timeline shifts, scope changes, or schedule realignments.
